title: Choose the Training Type by Situation
prompt: For each situation, select the most appropriate training type. Reason based on the trigger, not the topic covered.

items.label: New hire's first week: AUP and access
Onboarding session before a new administrator starts their role
Signing the policy acknowledgment upon hire
Mandatory annual training for all staff
Quarterly update module on emerging threats
BEC (wire fraud) session for the accounting department
Enhanced MFA training reserved for administrator accounts
Securing remote work for distributed teams
Individual coaching after clicking a simulated phishing link
Debriefing after sending data to the wrong recipient
Dedicated training following a breach involving a team

explain: Initial = arrival; continuous = calendar schedule; targeted = specific risk or role; corrective = observed mistake or incident. The same topic (passwords) can fall under multiple types depending on the trigger.
